item.title: NZ too much for Aust shearers
item.description: Mataura’s Dre Roberts shows his winning form in the senior shearing 12-sheep contest at the 60th anniversary Southern Shears in Gore. PHOTO: BARBARA NEWTON The New Zealand shearing team turned the tables on favourites Australia at the 60th anniversary Southern Shears shearing and woolhandling championships in Gore on Saturday night.

item.title: Council pays out leaseholder
item.description: Gore District Mayor Ben Bell says more stringent leases in the future will help prevent a repeat of the issues surrounding the closure of the Gore Motor Camp last month.

item.title: Pipe band in major need of leader
item.description: It will be big shoes to fill, but the Hokonui Celtic Pipe Band need a new drum major to lead them to continued national success. Photo: Gerrit Doppenberg The pipes, the pipes are calling — for a new drum major to take charge and lead the Hokonui Celtic Pipe Band.

item.title: Not so plane and simple
item.description: It’s quite a tale from Swedish pilots Stefan Samberg and Haakan Wiukander as they fly around New Zealand in their DH 80A Puss Moth, a restored plane from the 1930s, which ended up lost for a year after the container it was on was diverted. The two stopped off at the "Mecca" of vintage planes at the Croydon Aviation Centre at the weekend. item.description: PHOTO: GREGOR RICHARDSON Emergency services were called to a crash that blocked part of State Highway 1 in East Taieri for a time this evening.

item.title: Child looking for food on floor, trial told
item.description: The relative was testifying in the High Court at Nelson. Photo: RNZ A child who, according to their mother, was unable to eat was allegedly seen searching for crumbs of food off the floor during a family gathering.

item.description: Otago Nugget Matthew Bardsley (left) takes on Rangimarie Dougall-Mita of the Wellington Saints during a game in Dunedin last year. PHOTO: PETER MCINTOSH The Slippery Eel is back on the hook.

item.title: Manhunt after incident at Kaikorai service station
item.description: Armed police were called to the Z service station in Kaikorai Valley Rd tonight. PHOTO: GREGOR RICHARDSON Police are actively pursuing an offender after what appears to be an incident at the Z service station in Kaikorai Valley Rd.
